title: Solar and Battery Rebates in Coquitlam 2026: Up to $10,000
desc: Coquitlam solar and battery rebates for 2026. About 3.21 peak sun hours a day, 35% detached homes. Up to $5,000 for solar and $5,000 for a battery with Peak Saver.
h1: Solar and Battery Rebates in Coquitlam
lead: BC Hydro pays up to $5,000 for solar panels and up to $5,000 for a home battery in Coquitlam. A battery can keep your lights and fridge on in an outage; the rebate makes it cheaper.
cards_heading: What solar and battery rebates pay in Coquitlam
cards_intro: We re-read BC Hydro's solar and battery rebate page on October 3, 2026. The battery rebate is higher if you enroll it in Peak Saver. Every rebate is capped at 50% of what you paid.

cards.title: Solar panels
cards.note: $1,000 per kW of DC capacity, up to 50% of the installed cost.

cards.title: Battery with Peak Saver
cards.note: $500 per kWh, up to 50% of cost. Enroll in Peak Saver within 14 days of the in-service date. Battery-only allowed.

cards.title: Peak Saver battery reward
cards.note: One-time bill credit for enrolling, then a seasonal reward each winter you stay in.

cards.title: Tesla Powerwall
cards.note: Tesla batteries, inverters and chargers are not eligible for BC Hydro or CleanBC rebates.

sections: Coquitlam averaged about 3.21 peak sun hours a day from 2020 to 2024. Hillside homes facing south can do better than the average; homes on north slopes or under tall trees can do much worse. As a rough guide, a 5 kW system here would make about 4,687 kWh a year, using 3.21 sun hours times 365 days and assuming 80% of the panel rating reaches your panel after losses. Your installer's design for your own roof will be more accurate.
Most Coquitlam households own, so most can apply

The 2021 Census counted 55,945 households in Coquitlam. About 69% own (38,795 households) and about 31% rent (17,155), a higher share of owners than in Burnaby (about 60%) or Vancouver (about 45%) in the same table. A detached house is the home for 19,700 households, or 35%. BC Hydro's solar and battery rebates are for owners of single-family homes, duplexes, townhomes and mobile homes on its grid, so a larger share of Coquitlam homes can use them than in the neighbouring cities.
Homes built before 1991 and the roof

The Census counts 7,305 owner-occupied detached homes in Coquitlam built before 1981 and 4,055 built from 1981 to 1990, so about 11,360 in all are more than thirty years old. The roof is the part of the house the panels depend on. Ask each installer to check its age and condition and to say in the quote whether it should be replaced first. If it will need replacing within a few years, doing it before the panels go on can save you from paying to remove and reinstall them.
Burke Mountain and other community offers

BC Hydro runs community-based offers for select postal codes, and Burke Mountain is one of them. The offers we read list top-ups for heat pumps, EV chargers and appliances, not for solar or batteries. Check your postal code in BC Hydro's tool before you assume a top-up applies, and keep the solar and battery rebates on this page separate in your budget.

With 3.21 peak sun hours, Coquitlam's average is fine. Trees, hills and next-door buildings are what decide how much your own roof makes. A good quote includes a shade report with month-by-month output. If a third of the roof is shaded in winter, expect the yearly total to come in under the rough guide above.

A battery stores power for when the grid goes down. The rebate is $500 per kWh, so a 10 kWh battery that cost at least $10,000 can reach $5,000 with Peak Saver. Without Peak Saver, the battery must be paired with solar and the rebate stops at $1,500.
The 50% cap and the order of steps

Every rebate is limited to 50% of the installed cost. You must hire a contractor in the Home Performance Contractor Network and submit a self-generation application to BC Hydro before you install. Wait for technical acceptance. After install, send the final inspection documents and paid invoices. BC Hydro pays within 60 days of approval.
Tesla's Powerwall 2 and 3, Tesla inverters and Tesla chargers are not eligible for BC Hydro or CleanBC rebates. The only exception is an application made before March 12, 2025.

claim_steps: Confirm your home is on BC Hydro's grid.
Hire a Home Performance Contractor Network member.
Submit the self-generation application before you install, and wait for technical acceptance.
Install. Enroll the battery in Peak Saver within 14 days of the in-service date if you want the $5,000 battery rebate.
Send the final inspection documents and paid invoices.
faq: How much sun does Coquitlam get?
About 3.21 peak sun hours a day on average from 2020 to 2024, from the Open-Meteo historical archive.
What does Peak Saver ask of my battery?
BC Hydro can draw on it during a few winter peak events, November to March, for up to four hours. You can opt out of events, but opting out of more than half may cost you the seasonal reward.
Can I get the battery rebate without solar?
Yes, but only if you enroll the battery in Peak Saver. Then the battery-only rebate can reach $5,000.
No. Tesla batteries get $0 from BC Hydro and CleanBC.
Does Burke Mountain get extra solar money?
Not that we have found. BC Hydro's community-based offers we read cover heat pumps, EV chargers and appliances. Check its postal-code tool, because offers change.
Owners of single-family homes, duplexes, townhomes and mobile homes connected to BC Hydro's grid.
